correctness.rationale: The plane model has no affine points when x^7+x=0: x=0 gives RHS=1 and x^3=1 gives RHS=x !=0. The eight omitted ramification points are four F2-points for odd degree and eight over even-degree extensions, using Tafazolian Prop 7.2. Separately grouped the additive-polynomial image fibers for x in GF(2^n), n=1..9, recovering exact point counts [4,8,4,24,44,8,116,312,508]. Newton identities from s_n=2^n+1-N_n give first ten coefficients [1,1,2,0,2,2,-4,-8,-11,5]; the genus-nine functional equation supplies degree 10..18. Independent integer polynomial multiplication matches all four displayed factors, whose value at 1 is 1024. Finite checks supply the full numerator ONLY because the genus-nine Weil functional equation is separately invoked; higher-degree point counts were not enumerated. Tate semisimple isogeny decomposition supplies the factors but not a polarized isomorphism.
